events.title: Día de los Muertos at NYBG
events.what: Marigolds, a community ofrenda and flower-covered figures celebrate remembrance. Weekend craft sessions offer silk-flower making and papel picado. Closed Mondays except federal holidays.
events.where: New York Botanical Garden, the Bronx
events.when: Oct 3–Nov 2 · garden Tue–Sun 10 a.m.–6 p.m. and Monday federal holidays. Next craft sessions Oct 10–11, 11 a.m.–3 p.m.
events.cost: All-Garden adult pass: $35 weekdays / $39 weekends. NYC resident grounds-only option $15 on eligible days; confirm event access with your ticket.
events.imageAlt: NYBG seasonal ofrenda display

events.title: Oktoberfest at Watermark
events.what: Waterfront Oktoberfest with German beer, food, and seasonal decorations. Reservations and paid packages are available.
events.when: Sep 10–Oct 31 · check the organizer for daily hours
events.cost: General admission is free; food, drinks, and packages cost extra.
events.imageAlt: Watermark Oktoberfest in a previous season

events.title: Roy Lichtenstein: Like New
events.what: The Whitney’s Lichtenstein retrospective brings together iconic and less familiar Pop artworks, including recreations of four murals. Public opening is Oct 11; Oct 8–10 previews are for members.
events.when: Oct 11, 2026–May 10, 2027 · closed Tuesdays; Fridays open until 10 p.m.
events.cost: Standard adult admission $30; ages 25 and under free. Check free-admission dates and reserve.
events.imageAlt: Roy Lichtenstein, Girl in Window, 1963; © Estate of Roy Lichtenstein, courtesy Whitney Museum

events.title: The Surrealist Book: Tomorrow Lives in Mirrors
events.what: Newly opened: unusual artists’ books, collage-filled sketchbooks and sculptural bindings by Surrealists including Dalí, Cahun and Unica Zürn. Explore how a book can become an artwork.
events.when: Oct 4, 2026–Jan 23, 2027 · 10:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m.; Fridays until 8:30 p.m.
events.cost: Adult admission $30; special exhibitions included. NY State residents can reserve free Friday evening tickets.
events.imageAlt: Unica Zürn, Oracle and Spectacle, Book IV, 1960. MoMA; gift of Helen and Sam Zell. Photo: Ben Blackwell. © Verlag Brinkmann & Bose, Berlin.

events.title: L’AGENCE sample sale
events.what: Six days of discounted L’AGENCE clothing at the NoMad location. Item prices and stock vary.
events.when: Oct 13–18 · Tue–Sat 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–5 p.m.
events.cost: Prices vary; admission charge not specified.
events.imageAlt: L’AGENCE clothing in the official sample-sale photograph

events.title: Guest in Residence sample sale
events.what: Five days of knitwear shopping at the Lafayette Street location. The organizer calls this a final sale; individual prices and available sizes are not listed.
events.when: Oct 14–18 · Wed–Sat 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sun 11 a.m.–5 p.m.
events.cost: Prices vary; admission charge not specified
events.imageAlt: Guest in Residence organizer photograph

events.title: Outdoor Voices sample sale
events.what: A ten-day activewear sale at 468 Broadway. The detailed hours start Friday Oct 16; the introductory paragraph has an inconsistent weekday, so use the dated hours below.
events.cost: Prices vary; admission charge not specified
events.imageAlt: Outdoor Voices organizer photograph

events.title: Flower Power’s final weeks
events.what: Explore vivid botanical displays and installations inspired by 1960s flower culture, plus photography and visual art in the galleries. A closing-soon flower outing; an all-garden pass is needed for the special exhibition.
events.where: New York Botanical Garden · 2900 Southern Boulevard
events.when: Through Oct 18 · Tue–Sun 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; open Monday federal holidays
events.cost: All-Garden adults $35 weekdays / $39 weekends
events.imageAlt: Rainbow-colored flower sculpture inside a conservatory, from NYBG’s official Flower Power page

events.title: A guided look at early-fall flowers
events.what: Garden Guides lead an hour-long walk focused on early-autumn foliage, fruits and flowers. Meet on Magnolia Plaza by the building steps; no separate registration is required. Weather can cancel the walk.
events.cost: Tour included with admission: adult $22 at the box office / $23.67 online
events.imageAlt: Hardy begonias in the garden, photograph by Michael Stewart

events.title: Block by Block: Brooklyn’s green streets
events.what: A garden exhibition celebrates 30 years of neighbors transforming Brooklyn stoops and sidewalks with plants. Look for portraits and first-person stories from community gardeners and ideas to bring a little greenery home.
events.when: Through Oct 25 · Tue–Sun 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; open Oct 12. Oct 24 needs a festival ticket.
events.cost: Included with regular adult admission: $22 at the box office / $23.67 online; Oct 24 priced separately
events.imageAlt: Brooklyn streetscape gardening, official exhibition photograph

events.title: Open House New York Weekend
events.where: Participating buildings across all five boroughs
events.when: Oct 16–18 · festival listings generally 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; each site has its own hours
events.cost: Most sites free; some require advance tickets.
events.what: Explore architecture and spaces usually harder to get inside. Pick a neighborhood cluster from the lineup; drop-in sites need no reservation, but restricted-capacity locations require a ticket.
events.imageAlt: 620 Loft & Garden, photographed by Ben Helmer for OHNY; festival sites vary

events.title: October Saturdays at Queens Night Market
events.where: Behind New York Hall of Science · 47-01 111th Street
events.cost: Free admission; food and shopping extra.
events.what: The outdoor night market has a few October Saturdays left: browse art and merchandise stalls and check the weekly performance lineup. Discuss ingredients and cross-contact directly with vendors before ordering.
events.imageAlt: Queens Night Market organizer photograph

events.title: Pick a pumpkin at Queens Farm
events.where: Queens County Farm Museum · 73-50 Little Neck Parkway
events.when: October daily · weekdays 1–5 p.m.; weekends 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
events.cost: Patch admission free except ticketed Oct 31 Halloween event; pumpkins priced by size.
events.what: A pumpkin-picking option within the city. Combine the patch with a walk around the historic farm; allow extra travel time to eastern Queens.
events.imageAlt: Pumpkins at Queens County Farm Museum

events.title: Lakeside Fall Festival opens
events.where: LeFrak Center at Lakeside · 171 East Drive
events.when: Oct 8–Nov 1 · weekdays 4–10 p.m., weekends 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Oct 12 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Closed Oct 13–14 & 20–21.
events.cost: Pumpkin-patch entry free; pumpkins $10, corn maze $5, all-access pass $35. Haunted Hotel separate.
events.what: A seasonal park stop with pumpkin displays, carnival and lawn games, and crafts. Several attractions are family-oriented; the separate Haunted Hotel is the scarier option. Pair a short visit with a Prospect Park walk.
events.imageAlt: Lakeside café and surroundings before the festival; photo by Michael Moran / OTTO

events.title: Black Forest Brooklyn Oktoberfest
events.where: Smith Street: 181 Smith St · Fort Greene: 733 Fulton St
events.when: Oct 10: Smith St 4–7 p.m., Fort Greene 7–10 p.m. More parties Oct 17 & 24.
events.cost: Booking section lists from $35 + tax with seat and first 1L beer; another page banner says $33, so confirm total.
events.what: Live German music, Oktoberfest decorations and stein-holding contests. A nonalcoholic drink can replace the included beer. Choose the location and session when booking; food is additional.
events.imageAlt: Black Forest Brooklyn official restaurant photograph

events.title: Locating Girlhood opens at AFAM
events.where: American Folk Art Museum · 2 Lincoln Square
events.when: Oct 9–Feb 28 · Wed–Sun 11:30 a.m.–6 p.m.; closed Mon–Tue
events.cost: Free admission.
events.what: A new exhibition of roughly 100 works made by early American girls, including elaborate needlework, maps and painted objects. A compact, free art stop when you want something beyond shopping.
events.imageAlt: Needlework picture attributed to Faith Trumbull; Connecticut Museum / AFAM exhibition image

events.title: The Rink returns to Rockefeller Center
events.cost: Admission from $22 + $12 skate rental
events.what: Opening weekend for outdoor skating. Reserve a timed session; check in beneath 30 Rockefeller Plaza near Daily Provisions through Nov 13. The main 49th Street entrance returns Nov 14. Ticket availability varies.
events.imageAlt: The Rink at Rockefeller Center at night, organizer promotional photograph

events.title: Boucheron: In Focus at Christie’s
events.cost: Admission price not listed on the exhibition page
events.what: Explore a short-run exhibition of jewelry and design at Christie’s. The organizer offers a visit-booking option; reserve before making a special trip.
events.imageAlt: Boucheron: In Focus at Christie’s

events.title: Boo at the Zoo
events.cost: Dated zoo admission; price varies
events.what: Halloween programming alongside an autumn zoo visit, on weekends and the Oct 12 holiday. This is a family-oriented festival; choose it for animals, pumpkins and daytime fall atmosphere.
events.imageAlt: Bronx Zoo — image supplied on the organizer website

events.title: Harvest Festival by the waterfront
events.cost: Free walk-up admission; food purchases extra
events.what: A pumpkin-carving demonstration, fall activities and live music by the water. Hopalong Andrew plays at noon and Dolly Parton cover band Doll Parts at 2 p.m. Complimentary Brooklyn Roasting Company coffee is listed; this is a family-friendly daytime festival.
events.imageAlt: The prior Harvest Festival at Brooklyn Bridge Park, photo by Alexa Hoyer

events.title: The Morning Buzz: coffee, matcha & breakfast
events.where: The Rooftop at Pier 17 · 89 South Street
events.cost: $170; food, drinks, taxes and fees included
events.what: A splurge breakfast tasting with coffee, tea, matcha and morning bites on the waterfront. This NYC Wine & Food Festival session is hosted by mgk; it is a tasting event, not a concert.
events.imageAlt: The Morning Buzz: coffee, matcha & breakfast — organizer photograph

events.title: Tatou: Pacific Island dance, film & workshops
events.cost: Paid tickets; price varies by session and is not confirmed here
events.what: A three-day Pacific Island arts festival with performances, films and workshops. Choose a specific session on the organizer’s program; admission is not a single all-weekend ticket.
events.imageAlt: Tatou: Pacific Island dance, film & workshops — organizer photograph

events.title: Japan Fes on the Upper East Side
events.where: Upper East Side · exact block awaiting organizer details
events.cost: Admission not confirmed; food and shopping cost extra
events.what: The organizer has announced an Upper East Side edition with Japanese food and vendors. The date and neighborhood are confirmed; check the linked announcement for the final street location before heading out.
events.imageAlt: Japan Fes on the Upper East Side — organizer photograph

events.title: NewFest: choose an LGBTQ+ film premiere
events.where: Participating NYC cinemas · venue depends on screening
events.cost: Tickets and passes vary; check the selected screening
events.what: The festival’s in-person program includes more than 140 films. Browse by story or genre, then choose one screening; the venue and admission are tied to that individual booking.
events.imageAlt: Official NewFest film still from La Bola Negra

events.title: New York City Ballet’s fall season
events.where: David H. Koch Theater · 20 Lincoln Center Plaza
events.cost: Paid tickets; price depends on program and seat
events.what: Catch a fall repertory program before the season closes. Programs differ, so compare the ballets and running time before booking; this is a suggestion to explore the company, not a claim about a favorite performer.
events.imageAlt: New York City Ballet’s fall season — organizer photograph

events.title: Barktoberfest on the rooftop
events.cost: Free; RSVP required
events.what: A dog-costume celebration with rooftop views and pup-focused treats. You can enjoy the spectacle without planning a shopping trip; check the organizer’s registration and weather updates.
events.imageAlt: Barktoberfest on the rooftop — organizer photograph

events.title: Kouign-amann tasting & pastry contest
events.cost: Free; advance registration required
events.what: Professional bakers compete with their versions of the caramelized Breton pastry. Taste and vote at the public contest; ask individual vendors about ingredients and cross-contact before tasting.
events.imageAlt: Kouign-amann tasting & pastry contest — organizer photograph

events.title: Hallowscream & fall festivities
events.when: Oct 16 · fright walk 4–7 p.m.; Oct 17 · fall festival noon–3 p.m.
events.cost: Free; RSVP required
events.what: A neighborhood Halloween outing with a haunted walkthrough featuring jump scares and flashing lights. Saturday adds a pumpkin patch, crafts and games. Reserve free admission and wear comfortable closed-toe shoes.
events.imageAlt: NYC Parks official Hallowscream promotional photograph

events.title: Burger Bash on the waterfront
events.where: The Rooftop at Pier 17 · 89 South Street
events.cost: Standard GA $215, including food, drinks, tax and fees; qualifying offers may differ
events.what: A splurge burger tasting hosted by Rachael Ray and Bert Kreischer, with competing chefs and a waterfront setting. Compare the full ticket cost before booking; it replaces a whole food-and-drink evening.
events.imageAlt: Burger Bash on the waterfront — organizer photograph

events.title: Halloween movie nights at Sadie’s
events.cost: Free screening; food and drinks optional and extra
events.what: The outdoor series shows Halloweentown on Oct 14, Practical Magic on Oct 21 and Hocus Pocus on Oct 28. Pick the film you want and bring an extra layer; purchases are separate from the screening.
events.imageAlt: Sadie’s official venue photograph

events.title: Manhattan Vintage Fall Show
events.cost: $25 one-day / $35 three-day / $20 student; purchases extra.
events.what: Browse vintage clothing and accessories from more than 100 dealers. This is a ticketed vintage fair, with individual sellers setting their prices. Photo is from a previous show.
events.imageAlt: A woman in a black leather jacket browses a clothing rack in a boutique, holding up a fluffy cream faux fur collar.

events.title: Washington Square dog costume contest
events.cost: Free to attend.
events.what: Watch the neighborhood dogs parade in costume. Spectators can simply come by; contestants queue from 9:30 a.m. and registration closes at 10:30 a.m.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Hampus Öhman-Frölund: Motvalsen
events.cost: Paid ticket; current price not confirmed on the public event page.
events.what: A Swedish percussionist blends drums, electronics and folk-inspired textures in a solo performance. A nearby musical discovery, rather than a claim that this is one of your favorite artists.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Carl Schurz Harvest Festival & Halloween Howl
events.where: Gracie Oval, East End Avenue at 88th Street; dog festivities at John Finley Walk
events.cost: Public festival; any activity or contest fees are not listed.
events.what: Pumpkin decorating while supplies last, a spooky trail and a dog costume event make this an easy autumn park outing. The harvest activities are family-oriented.
events.imageAlt: IMG_5408.jpeg

events.title: Stakt Game Day at Lawn Club
events.when: Oct 17–18 · check the pop-up schedule for individual sessions
events.cost: Complimentary wellness activations and lawn games; workout/session prices not confirmed.
events.what: A two-day fitness-brand pop-up with movement classes, a Good Grief podcast recording and wellness activities. Check registration for the specific session you want.
events.imageAlt: two young adults putting lawn billiards at lawn club

events.title: Esther Yi in conversation with Katy Waldman
events.cost: $5 admission.
events.what: A bookshop conversation about Esther Yi’s novel To God. Reserve a seat for an indoor literary outing; the photo shows the bookstore.
events.imageAlt: a group of customers shop for books at the mcnally jackson bookstore at the seaport

events.title: Pier 17 pumpkin arch
events.cost: Free; no RSVP required.
events.what: A pumpkin-covered waterfront arch for a short fall stroll and photos. Come for the installation itself; rooftop concerts and Halloween parties are separate events.
events.imageAlt: Pumpkin Arch

events.title: Steve Aoki: Dim Mak 30th anniversary
events.where: The Rooftop at Pier 17 · 89 South Street
events.when: Oct 24 · doors/show from 5 p.m.; rooftop events end by 10 p.m.
events.cost: Paid concert ticket; current AXS price not confirmed.
events.what: An outdoor electronic-music show on the rooftop. Runs rain or shine; check ticket age rules and availability. This is a music discovery, not a remembered favorite.
events.imageAlt: The Rooftop at Pier 17 Stage View during a Concert

events.title: A Haunted Harbor ferry outing
events.where: Starts in Long Island City; finishes aboard Wavertree at the Seaport
events.cost: $20; confirm inclusions and meeting location when booking.
events.what: Cross the East River with short talks on New York folklore, then gather aboard the historic ship for autumn refreshments and conversation. The starting watering hole is supplied with the booking details.
events.imageAlt: Tall Ship Wavertree

events.title: Spirits of the Season at Urban Cove
events.cost: Complimentary Rosaluna tastings; food and other cocktails cost extra.
events.what: Explore a Día de los Muertos installation and seasonal drinks at the kickoff evening. An adult bar outing with tastings and giveaways.
events.imageAlt: the interior at urban cove

events.title: Jazz at Ralph Ellison Plaza
events.cost: Free.
events.what: Local musicians and vocalists perform outdoors in the Let the Music Play series. Seating is limited and first come; heavy rain cancels the concert.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: NYBG fall foliage tour
events.where: Reflecting Pool · Leon Levy Visitor Center, New York Botanical Garden
events.cost: Included in an All-Garden Pass; confirm the date-specific ticket price.
events.what: Join a guided look at the garden’s changing autumn colors. The tour has a fixed start, so allow time to reach the visitor center after entering.
events.imageAlt: Autumn forest path at NYBG, organizer photograph

events.title: Tompkins Square Halloween Dog Parade
events.where: Avenue B; festival block on East 6th between Avenues B and C
events.when: Oct 17 · parade 11 a.m.; festival block 10 a.m.–4 p.m.
events.cost: Spectators welcome without registration; shopping and refreshments extra.
events.what: Watch the costumes from Avenue B. Registration to march is already full; the organizer suggests spectators arrive around 10–10:30 a.m. Photo shows an earlier parade.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Merchant’s House candlelight ghost tours
events.where: Merchant’s House Museum · enter through Manuel Plaza, 35 East 4th Street
events.when: Oct 16–17, 23–24 and 29–30 · 50-minute tours start every half-hour, 6:30–9 p.m.
events.cost: $45; museum members $35.
events.what: A candlelit tour of the preserved 19th-century house, with guides recounting its ghost stories and reported paranormal encounters. Book a departure. During restoration, use the Manuel Plaza entrance. Photo shows the historic passageway.
events.imageAlt: Merchant’s House historic passageway; photograph by Max Touhey

events.title: Mahjong & Martinis at Sadie’s
events.cost: $80 beginner lesson / $45 open play; includes a martini and fries.
events.what: Choose a lesson if you are new to the game, or an open-play seat if you already know it. A social game-night suggestion; reserve the appropriate ticket.
events.imageAlt: the exterior patio seating at sadie

events.title: Bryant Park Winter Village opens
events.where: Bryant Park · Sixth Avenue at 42nd Street
events.when: Opens Oct 28; rink season through Feb 28, 2027
events.cost: Free entry and skating admission with your own skates. Rentals $18.72–$64.48 before tax; reserve.
events.what: The winter market and rink return. Save this opening if you want a skating outing; the organizer lists a noon opening event, so check your reserved slot rather than assuming regular morning hours apply that day.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Nightfall at Green-Wood
events.cost: $70 general admission / $95 premium; 21+.
events.what: An after-dark cemetery evening of performance, music and atmospheric encounters. Premium admission includes two drinks and a pin; choose a night and book ahead.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Tarot & ’Tinis at Sadie’s
events.when: Oct 22 · choose 7 or 8 p.m. arrival; event ends 9 p.m.
events.cost: Paid ticket; public page does not list the price. Gratuity extra.
events.what: A playful dinner outing including an entrée, cocktail and a private ten-minute tarot reading. Steak frites is excluded. Treat the reading as entertainment.
events.imageAlt: the interior and main dining room at sadie

events.title: Green-Wood moonlight walking tour
events.where: Gothic Arch · Green-Wood main entrance, 500 25th Street
events.cost: $30; members $24.
events.what: A guided walk through the cemetery’s history, romances and scandals. Expect hilly, grassy and uneven paths, and wear suitable walking shoes.
events.imageAlt: Organizer photograph

events.title: Domino Square Fall Festival
events.cost: Check the free-RSVP listing; food, pumpkins and optional purchases may cost extra.
events.what: Fall crafts, face painting, a pumpkin patch and beginner-friendly contra dancing. No partner is needed for the dance; the event also collects gently used baby and children’s items for donation.
events.imageAlt: Fall Festival
